name: Isle of Palms
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Isle of Palms, SC 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids on Isle of Palms, SC in 2026: a Front Beach tree lighting, Santa breakfast, cookie workshop and Wild Dunes holiday events.
lede: Isle of Palms keeps Christmas close to the beach, with a Front Beach street festival and tree lighting, a free cookie workshop and holiday events at Wild Dunes Resort.
celebrates: The City of Isle of Palms Recreation Department anchors the season with the Holiday Street Festival at Front Beach, where the city lists arts and crafters, food vendors, children's activities, live entertainment, local shopping and restaurants, Santa Claus and a tree lighting. The department also runs Santa's Cookie Workshop at the Recreation Center, which its activity guide lists as free for kids who come with an adult. Wild Dunes Resort adds its own Holiday Festival tree lighting at the Sweetgrass Inn, a Breakfast with Santa at Indigo Rooftop and a free storytelling event led by Santa's Elves.
lastyear: We did not find a city recap of the 2025 season, so this page leans on the city's own 2026 pages. A local real estate team's 2025 guide listed the Holiday Street Festival at Front Beach with live music, kids' activities, local vendors, food trucks and the annual tree lighting at dusk. The same guide listed a Santa's Cookie Workshop in December with cookie decorating, crafts and holiday fun, which the city now holds at its Recreation Center.
facts: The Isle of Palms Recreation Center is at 24 28th Avenue, and the Magnolia Room there hosts the department's cookie workshop and other classes. Front Beach, the setting for the Holiday Street Festival, is on Ocean Boulevard. Wild Dunes Resort sits at 5757 Palm Boulevard and serves its Santa breakfast at Indigo Rooftop in 90 minute seatings. The Charleston Area Convention and Visitors Bureau lists Wild Dunes' storytelling event on its Christmas in Charleston calendar, and the city's Recreation Department answers questions at 843 886 8294.
trains: We did not find a holiday train ride on Isle of Palms this season, and the island's Christmas events center on the beach, the Recreation Center and Wild Dunes Resort. Families who want a train stop on the same trip can visit the Best Friend Train Museum in downtown Charleston, which Rally lists with free admission and a full size replica of the Best Friend of Charleston, the first locomotive built entirely in the United States.
train_links: A full size replica of the first locomotive built entirely in the United States, with free admission in downtown Charleston.

kidfact: At Santa's Cookie Workshop on Isle of Palms, every cookie and supply is provided, so kids only need to bring a grown up and their imagination.
faq: Is there a Christmas tree lighting on Isle of Palms?

Yes. The city's Holiday Street Festival at Front Beach ends with a tree lighting at 5:30 pm, with Santa Claus on hand earlier in the day. Wild Dunes Resort also holds a Christmas tree lighting at sundown as part of its Holiday Festival at the Sweetgrass Inn, which includes dinner.
Can kids meet Santa on Isle of Palms?

Yes. Santa Claus appears at the city's Holiday Street Festival at Front Beach and at the Wild Dunes Holiday Festival, and he joins families for Breakfast with Santa at Indigo Rooftop. Santa's Elves also tell Christmas stories at Wild Dunes, with free tickets and reservations required.
Are there free Christmas events for kids on Isle of Palms?

Yes. Santa's Cookie Workshop at the Recreation Center is listed as free, and Christmas Stories at Wild Dunes has complimentary tickets with required reservations. The Holiday Street Festival at Front Beach is a city event, and the city's page mentions no ticket.
Do Wild Dunes holiday events cost money?

Most do. The Holiday Festival tree lighting dinner and Breakfast with Santa are priced by age, with children 3 and under complimentary, and both add a service charge and tax. The storytelling event is free with a reservation. Check the resort's events calendar for the current prices before you book.
Where is the Isle of Palms Holiday Street Festival held?

It is held at Front Beach on Ocean Boulevard, in the part of the island with local shops and restaurants. The city's Recreation Department organizes it and lists arts and crafters, food vendors, children's activities and live entertainment. Questions go to the department at 843 886 8294.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Isle of Palms for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (The Holiday Festival tree lighting at Wild Dunes Resort) through December 19 (Christmas Stories with Santa's Elves at Wild Dunes), with the Holiday Street Festival and tree lighting at Front Beach (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Indigo Rooftop (December 13) and Santa's Cookie Workshop at the Recreation Center (December 17) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
